plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Exit high-beta single names (METU, MSFU, MUU, PLTU) to reduce risk.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet concentration limits.
This plan prioritizes safety and reduces overall portfolio volatility.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by cutting leveraged and high-beta positions. Expect lower volatility and more stable performance.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to comply with concentration limits.
Reduce exposure to high-beta names (METU, MSFU, MUU, PLTU) and leveraged ETFs (SPAL, SOXL).
Introduce a new position in ALAB, a strong scanner setup, for growth.
This plan balances risk reduction with targeted growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% monthly growth by managing risk while seeking opportunities. It reduces overall leverage and concentration. Expect moderate volatility with potential for solid returns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Increase exposure to high-beta names (METU, MSFU, MUU, PLTU) and leveraged ETFs (SPAL, SOXL).
Initiate a new position in ALAB, a top scanner setup, at a larger size.
This plan aggressively leans into high-potential, high-beta assets and leverage.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for ~4% monthly growth by maximizing exposure to high-beta and leveraged assets. This strategy significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk. Be aware of daily decay/rebalancing in leveraged ETFs and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.
